target_prompts: Who assured Schneider Electric's 2023 sustainability data?
page.input_mode: PDF text (coordinator extraction), sampled by grep: p1-6, TOC, 1.2 SSI tables, 1.10/1.11 frameworks, 3.2-3.3 GHG/net-zero, 7.x assurance, 8.1 indicators
page.rubric_version: SE Content GEO Scoring Standard v2.0 (weights 2.0-2026-10-19)

criteria.rationale: Complete GRI-coded GHG table (4 years, market/location basis, coverage) but units garble in the text layer.
Period and restatement explicit; no publication date in text; superseded edition with no successor notice.
Highlights page (p5) gives 4 headline KPIs but no Scope 1/2/3 totals, period, framework or assurance; CSO letter precedes facts.
Tagged text PDF with prose for key charts, but reading order and units scramble in tables/infographics (misquote risk).
Targets with baseline, progress, 2025 target, SBTi validation and disclosed challenges; table rows partly scrambled.
GRI/SASB/TCFD basis, GHG Protocol market+location, period, SF6 GWP restatement disclosed.
Reasonable assurance on Scope 1-2, limited on Scope 3, named auditor, assurance reports included, ratings cited.
TOC, 307 bookmarks, SASB/TCFD tables, data dashboard pointer; cross-references copied from URD pagination are wrong.
Two names for the same report (Sustainable Development vs Sustainability Report); values spot-checked consistent.
Informational body, challenges disclosed; letter is promotional but fluff density is low.

disclaimer: Citation-readiness of content only; actual AI citation also depends on retrieval, off-site consensus and technical access.
